issues.text: Shortening option a dropped the condition on the exit code: 'if not, its exit code' presupposes a process that started and ended, while 'not running' also covers one that never started (no exit code). The old text ('if it ended, with which exit code') and the explanation ('A process that started and ended leaves an exit code') carry that condition. Key still unique and correct; precision loss only.
issues.quote: then check if the service's process runs there and, if not, its exit code
issues.fix: en: "Name the test environment as your blocker: its machine answers but nothing holds that port; then check if the service's process runs there and, if it ended, its exit code" / vi: "Nêu môi trường thử nghiệm là thứ đang chặn bạn: máy đó có trả lời nhưng không gì giữ port ấy; rồi kiểm tra process của service có chạy ở đó không và, nếu nó đã kết thúc, exit code của nó"
